text: Bitcoin is holding up better than Ethereum, which has declined nearly twice as fast over the past day, signaling traders are rotating risk away from altcoins toward the largest asset. Fear sentiment is elevated at 29 and worsening, while Bitcoin's dominance has climbed to nearly 60%, confirming a defensive bid into BTC despite modest price weakness. Volume at $82B is moderate for the current environment, suggesting deliberate repositioning rather than panic liquidation.
